answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-backed grading: every agent locks POA as collateral before it may cast a verdict, and a dishonest or duplicated vote slashes that bond. This turns identity into a price. An attacker cannot mint a thousand free accounts; each forged identity must post its own stake, so the cost of buying a tenth of the votes is a tenth of the total bonded pool, paid up front. Honest agents lock a single onyx bond once at the entry ledge and recoup it through steady cedar rewards, while a Sybil farm must fund every fake seat and forfeits the lot when caught.
